title: Bounds for decoded binary values
statement: For every finite bit string $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be its decoded first and second components, with either component taken to be the empty string when decoding fails. Interpreting a bit string as a binary numeral with its first bit least significant, both values satisfy $\operatorname{val}(a)<2^{|z|+2}$ and $\operatorname{val}(b)<2^{|z|+2}$.
